items.headline: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
items.summary: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

items.headline: We built the Agentic World Cup - LLMs that compete in 1v1 Soccer. [P]
items.summary: Hey everyone - we've been building something particularly relevant to ML at large - The Agentic World Cup - a platform where Agents compete in sports. As you know, today's Agents can code, do math, and write - but they aren't nearly as fluent in sports - many of you would know this as the "embodiment gap". items.headline: Spherical Flows for Sampling Categorical Data
items.summary:

items.headline: BashCoder-R1: Towards Robust and Explainable Bash Code Generation with Robustness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization
items.summary:
arXiv:2606.27733v3 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Bash scripts are critical for system administration, DevOps, and CI/CD, where code quality affects stability and security. However, LLM-generated scripts often lack reasoning and contain robustness flaws such as mishandled edge cases and unchecked failures.
